channel.title: Articles by Dilshad
channel.description: Articles by Dilshad, an independent cryptocurrency trader and entrepreneur in Trivandrum, Kerala, India, on risk management, discipline and trading psychology.

item.title: Position Sizing Explained for Crypto Traders
item.author: iam@dilshad.co (Dilshad)
item.description: What position sizing is and why it matters more than entries. A plain explanation from Dilshad, a cryptocurrency trader in Kerala, India.

item.title: Trading Psychology and Emotional Discipline in Crypto
item.author: iam@dilshad.co (Dilshad)
item.description: Fear, greed and impatience move more trades than charts do. Dilshad, a cryptocurrency trader in Kerala, India, on emotional discipline in crypto markets.

item.title: Risk Management in Crypto Trading: Dilshad's Approach
item.author: iam@dilshad.co (Dilshad)
item.description: How Dilshad, an independent cryptocurrency trader in Kerala, India, thinks about risk management: position size, planned losses, and staying in the game.

item.title: Discipline vs Luck in Crypto Trading
item.author: iam@dilshad.co (Dilshad)
item.description: Why one successful trade can be luck, but consistent results come from discipline. Dilshad, a cryptocurrency trader in Kerala, India, explains his philosophy.
